canDoYue: 你識攞證書同書面估價、問保險收唔收相片、同埋問第二次估價幾多錢。
canDoEn: Ask whether a written appraisal and a certificate photo are enough for an insurance claim.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: I brought the damaged pendant back, and I need a written appraisal before the insurance claim goes in.
dialogue.glossYue: 我帶咗隻爛咗嘅吊墜返嚟，保險索償之前要一份書面估價。
dialogue.say: I brought the damaged pendant back, and I need a written appraisal before the insurance claim goes in.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The certificate is in this folder, and it matches the stone we photographed last spring in the shop.
dialogue.glossYue: 證書喺呢個文件夾，同我哋春天喺舖頭影嘅石一致。
dialogue.say: The certificate is in this folder, and it matches the stone we photographed last spring in the shop.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Does the written appraisal still stand if the clasp was repaired after that short shop visit?
dialogue.glossYue: 上次短短嚟舖修咗扣之後，書面估價仲算唔算數？
dialogue.say: Does the written appraisal still stand if the clasp was repaired after that short shop visit?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. The clasp repair still stands, and the note is attached at the back of the file.
dialogue.glossYue: 算。扣嘅維修仍然有效，字條釘咗喺檔案最後。
dialogue.say: Yes. The clasp repair still stands, and the note is attached at the back of the file.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Can the insurance office accept a clear photo of the certificate instead of sending the paper original?
dialogue.glossYue: 保險公司可唔可以收證書嘅清晰相片，唔使寄紙本正本？
dialogue.say: Can the insurance office accept a clear photo of the certificate instead of sending the paper original?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The office can accept that photo this afternoon, and I will email a scanned copy of the certificate.
dialogue.glossYue: 公司今日下晝可以收嗰張相，我會電郵證書嘅掃描副本。
dialogue.say: The office can accept that photo this afternoon, and I will email a scanned copy of the certificate.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: What is the fee if the pendant needs a second appraisal before the claim is filed?
dialogue.glossYue: 索償之前吊墜要再估一次，收費係幾多？
dialogue.say: What is the fee if the pendant needs a second appraisal before the claim is filed?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The second appraisal is free of charge, and the pendant fee stays at forty dollars in the quote.
dialogue.glossYue: 第二次估價唔使錢，吊墜收費喺報價度維持四十蚊。
dialogue.say: The second appraisal is free of charge, and the pendant fee stays at forty dollars in the quote.
